where: module/rules/kinds/bonus.mjs, the Defense branch of a check; ruling 222 (0.21.0)
question: Ruling 222 lets a bonus to a Maneuver reach a check rolled with a Defense Constellation from that Maneuver's Item (Humanity's +1 on an Aid made with Awareness). Should a bonus to every check, and a bonus to a Maneuver made without its Item, also reach a Defense rolled as a check (Wind's Endure, a Recovery, a Search with Awareness)? Today neither does: nothing is applied and nothing is offered there.
recommendation: Yes, as its own ruling, with a Wind roll driven live, because it changes numbers outside Aid.

where: module/rules/kinds/substitute.mjs, the third descriptor of USE; rulings 219 and 111
question: A USE line names a Maneuver's check and nothing wider (ruling 219); a Constellation there is refused ('a Constellation's own checks are not read yet'). When a Talent wants a Constellation as the check a USE names, does the swap carry into an Initiative rolled with that Constellation? Ruling 111 (an Initiative rolled with a Constellation carries every modifier of that Constellation's check) argues yes.
recommendation: Settle it with the first Talent that names one; the refusal stands until then.

where: data/ancestries.xlsx, the Human sheet in progress (Mike's, uncommitted)
question: 16 Automation cells on the Human sheet hold only '# PROPOSED' notes naming tags the grammar does not have (ALTER, PREPARE, CONDITION and extra IF conditions), Jack of All Trades' and Quick Study's among them, so those Talents automate nothing once the sheet builds; and Torchbearer Human's cell no longer carries the Rally Aura. Which comes first?
recommendation: Pick the next kind from them with Claude, one at a time (ruling 119), from the Talent that wants it most; the others stay '#' notes, which the grammar reads as comments, until their kind exists. Five cells can be pasted today, printed in the 0.22.0 and 0.24.0 changelog entries and in AUTOMATION_GRAMMAR.md section 5: Aid's five GIVE lines, Patient Assistance's and Sure Assistance's ALTER lines (0.22.0), '[EFFECT PERMIT: move; FOR: allies 0; LIMIT: round]' on Move Together's row and '[EFFECT ALTER: Move Together.movement; VALUE: step]' on Coordinated Footwork (0.24.0).

where: PHB v4.24, Conditions table; Drop Prone, Stand, Kip Up
question: Supine is in the Conditions table with an empty Effects cell, and Drop Prone, Stand and Kip Up name it. What does Supine do (Prone's -2 to Attacks and Off-Guard? a different Evade clause?), or should the word go?
recommendation: Define it in the book in one line (if it is Prone face-up with no mechanical difference, say so and the system treats it as Prone); the system adds nothing until the cell is filled (ruling 213).

recommendation: Write the Murovian sheet and its Lore sheet when the Culture is authored; until then the row costs one warning a run. Delete it only if the Culture is dropped.

where: data/maneuvers.xlsx, 17 rows
question: Steady the Line, Quench the Ember, Glimmer, Quick Tongue, Oathbound, Tumbling Retreat, Kip Up, Sure Seat, Bull Rush, Reliable Anchor, Rally, Talk Them Down, Command the Field, Feinting Step, Battle Cry, No Quarter and Lost in the Dark are typed 'Maneuver' though a Talent grants each.
recommendation: Retype them 'Talent Maneuver'. The build reads them as granted meanwhile (ruling 207), so nothing ships wrong; the retype just silences the build line.

where: data/maneuvers.xlsx Culture Actions / Rescue Haul; data/cultures.xlsx Cairnward

recommendation: Add [MANEUVER Rescue Haul] to the Cairnward Talent that grants it and @Maneuver[Rescue Haul] to its Effect, as Steady the Line's and Oathbound's do.

where: ancestries.xlsx (Dwarf, Elf, Gnome, Halfling), maneuvers.xlsx Ancestry Actions
question: Eight Automation lines want something the grammar has no kind for: a forced-movement cap (Hold Your Ground), a degree-of-success downgrade (Unclouded Mind), a Size condition (Small Opening), a Swim Speed (Riverkin), ending Persistent damage (Quench the Ember), a terrain kind 'roots' (Greenblood), a check target 'repair' (Small Ingenuity), a bare REROLL with a CLAIM (Halfling Fortune). In release mode parse_rules stops on the first of them.
recommendation: Pick the next kind to author with Claude, one at a time (ruling 119), from the Talent that wants it most; rewrite the others as prose (or blank the cell) until their kind exists, so the release pipeline passes. Greenblood's 'roots' is a terrainKinds row in assets/roster.json, no code.

where: Starwrought_Players_Handbook_v4.24.docx, cover table

where: PHB v4.24, Traits table (Exploration) and the Activities table
question: The Exploration trait says 'you can Move up to half your Speed' while Travel is Full and Hustle Double in the Activities table.
recommendation: Reword the trait to defer to the table's Speed column ('your Travel Speed is the Activity's Speed'); the system reads the table.

question: The five caster Callings are disabled (blank Enabled?), so they and their Talents are not in the Foundry packs. Deliberate?

where: World setting "Track the six-action round" (trackActions)
question: The setting has only ever switched off the spending for movement, and since 0.23.0 for a Maneuver used from the sheet (ruling 236). Strikes, Casts, Reactions, Raise a Shield, Recenter and drawing or stowing a weapon are paid whether it is on or off, although its hint said otherwise until 0.23.0. Should Off stop those as well?
recommendation: Leave it as it is. A Strike or a Cast is declared through the attack flow, which refunds on Cancel and reads the pool, so an unpaid Strike would be a second path to keep right; a table that wants no counting can ignore the pips, which nothing enforces.

where: data/maneuvers.xlsx Athletics Actions, Grapple
question: Grapple prints a cost of nought with an Athletics check against Evade, so since 0.23.0 it is the one Maneuver that rolls an attack-like check and pays nothing. Shove, Trip and Reposition beside it cost one or two.
recommendation: Read as a slip: give Grapple the cost the book prints for it, and the row pays it the next time the content builds.

where: data/maneuvers.xlsx Cost cells: Battle Cry, Lost in the Dark, Reliable Anchor, Steady the Line, Sure Seat, Quick Tongue, No Quarter, Grab an Edge
question: These rows have a Trigger and no Reaction glyph in their Cost, so the system reads each as a plain Maneuver. Since 0.23.0 a plain Maneuver used from the sheet pays its cost, so the five that cost one action pay it from their row and wait for the GM off-turn (Quick Tongue pays from its card button; the two at nought pay nothing). The same is true of any row whose empty Cost cell reads as one action.
recommendation: Write the cost with its Reaction glyph in each Cost cell (Battle Cry is nought with the glyph in the book). A Reaction is paid the moment it is used and never waits for the GM.

where: foundry/starwrought/module/documents/item.mjs, the Reaction branch of a Maneuver's use
question: A row printed with a cost and a Reaction half of its own, as Aid once was (one action, with a free Reaction), pays the Reaction half whenever it is used and never the printed cost. No shipped row is written so today.
recommendation: If such a row returns: used at your own Opportunity it is the Maneuver and pays the printed cost; used at any other time it is the Reaction and pays the half. Say the word and it is a small change.
